'''Tilak Raj Prabhakar''' was an Indian mathematician specializing in [[special functions]] and [[integral equation]]s. In a paper published in 1971, he introduced a three-parameter extension of the [[Mittag-Leffler function]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=T. R. Prabhakar |title=A singular integral equation with a generalized Mittag–Leffler function in the kernel |journal=Yokohama Math. Journal |date=1971 |volume=19 |issue=1 |pages=7–15}}</ref> Subsequently, this function was found to have applications in various areas of mathematics like [[fractional calculus]] and also in certain areas of physics. The function has since been named "[[Prabhakar function]]" in his honor.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Andrea Giusti, Ivano Colombaro, Roberto Garra|title=A practical guide to Prabhakar fractional calculus |journal=Fractional Calculus and Applied Analysis |date=2020 |volume=23 |issue=1 |url=https://www.degruyter.com/document/doi/10.1515/fca-2020-0002/pdf |access-date=26 December 2023|pages = 9–54|doi=10.1515/fca-2020-0002 |doi-access=free |arxiv=2002.10978 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Francesco Mainardi and Roberto Garrappa |title=On complete monotonicity of the Prabhakar function and non-Debye relaxation in dielectrics |journal=Journal of Computational Physics |date=July 2015 |volume=293 |pages=70–80 |doi=10.1016/j.jcp.2014.08.006 |arxiv=1610.01763 |bibcode=2015JCoPh.293...70M |s2cid=29142283 |url=https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/link_gateway/2015JCoPh.293...70M/arxiv:1610.01763 |access-date=26 December 2023}}</ref>

== Education ==
Prabhakar received his M.A. and B.A. degrees from the [[Benaras Hindu University]] (India) and obtained his PhD. from the [[University of Delhi]] in 1970 with his thesis on "Integral Equations and Special Functions".

== Career ==
Initially, he taught at the S.D. College in [[Muzaffargarh|Muzzaffarnagar]]. Then he joined the [[Multani Mal Modi College]] in [[Modinagar]] where he became Head of the Department of Mathematics and later he moved to the Ramjas College of the University of Delhi. He was professor of mathematics at the National Institute of Electricity and Electronics in [[Boumerdès|Boomerdès, Algeria]] when he died in 1982.<ref>{{cite journal |title=Untimely demise of Dr. Tilak Raj Prabhakar |journal=Ganita Bharati |date=1982 |volume=4 |issue=1 |pages=i-ii}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Roberto Garra and Roberto Garrappa |title=The Prabhakar or three parameter Mittag–Leffler function: theory and application |journal=Communications in Nonlinear Science and Numerical Simulation |date=March 2018 |volume=56 |pages=314–329|doi=10.1016/j.cnsns.2017.08.018 |arxiv=1708.07298 |bibcode=2018CNSNS..56..314G }}</ref>
